data.name: Dream Coaster VR Remastered
data.detailed_description:
Dream Coaster VR will put the definition of roller coaster simulator on the whole new level of entertainment!

We invite you for this unforgettable ride through magical grounds of Fantasy Land, where absolutely everything can awaits you around the bend.
Do not let the name trick you - this rollercoaster will surely keep you wide awake!

Travel between reality and dream while moving around the whole spectrum of different environmental themes - from Wonderland woods, through majestic volcanic mountains straight to the mysterious cave mouth! All of them created with care about every detail in the highest quality 3D graphics powered by Unreal Engine.
The thrill of immersion will consume you completely! Prepare for intense sensations you can’t even dreamed about!

Attention: Dream Coaster VR track is meant to be confusingly realistic - be aware of ultra immersive impression of height and speed experience!

Features:
- diverse environmental themes
- breathtaking landscapes
- marvelous track and thrilling turns
- outstanding high quality 3D graphics
- ultra immersive height and speed experience
- series of confusingly realistic impressions
- constantly growing level of excitement


Enjoyed the ride? Be sure to try medieval Rift Coaster HD, also available on Steam!

reviews.review:
[h1]Played On: [b]HTC Vive[/b][/h1]

Roller coaster games were one of the earliest concepts when virtual reality started to trickle onto the mainstream market. Now that we're entering a more advanced era of the technology, these coaster games are becoming more obsolete and much less impressive over time. Most of them only cost a couple of dollars, or about $0.60 CAD on sale, and they generally only last 3-5 minutes tops.

Dream Coaster VR happened to come in to existence during the "obsolete" and "less impressive over time" era of VR gaming. With that said, you would think that it would've tried harder to introduce a more outstanding environment to take place in. The coaster goes through all sorts of fantasy lands, which in themselves aren't too bad but we've already seen most of this in the Rift Coaster title; both of which were developed by VR Visio. 

However, this is the blurriest roller coaster ride that I've ever taken. If you look anywhere but straight ahead, you'll see nothing but a blurry mess rushing by you. Despite optimization fixes, on a GTX 1080 the game still manages to stutter in areas, and for some reason the game casts a horrible glare on the lenses. I'm not one to bash coaster games in general, but there are far better ones out there; ones that display much higher innovation, rather than leeching off of their own predecessor. It's true that you get what you pay for, but you might as well pass on this one.

[h1]Rating: [b]1.5/5.0[/b] - It's Bad.[/h1]
